About This Group

Honey & Bee Products — 5 canonical sweet flavor ingredients in the Sweet Flavor Ontology.

Honey and bee products in the Sweet Flavor Ontology — culinary sweeteners only: honey and comb honey. Bee pollen, royal jelly, and propolis are excluded (supplement scope, not mainstream culinary sweeteners).
